original_text: 5.3 –Opening Question¨Examine the tortoises from Lesson 1 to the left.¨With a partner, determine what evidence could be used to make the case for each of the tortoises below to be grouped into their own unique species. How could a scientist verify each species as unique?
explanation: This slide opens Section 5.3 by asking students to revisit the tortoises from Lesson 1. It prompts a partner discussion on what biological evidence could be used to justify classifying each tortoise variety into its own unique species, and how scientists can empirically verify that a species is indeed distinct.

questions.q: What is the focus of the opening question on Page 51?
opts: To calculate the allele frequencies of tortoises using Hardy-Weinberg equations
To discuss what evidence can show tortoises are distinct species and how to verify it
To examine the fossil record of early tortoises in Argentina
To map out the Hox genes in tortoise embryos
questions.exp: The opening question asks students to discuss what evidence distinguishes tortoise species and how scientists verify species uniqueness.
